prose_findings.claim: Sampled backend motion before t=0.30 s (0.01-0.29 s, 29 samples) was not read
prose_findings.assessment: The prediction query for updates 27-34 returned measured endpoints at 0.28 and 0.29000000000000004 s. The structured queried final-window declaration passed, but the prose incorrectly describes all earlier samples as unread. Cross-view receipts already contain those timestamps.

No explicit terminal-speed penalty is too broad: terminal_velocity_weight is nonzero. The supported observation is zero direct terminal/holding tip-speed weights, without establishing the importance of generalized-velocity costs.

Instantaneous braking-box input maximizes instantaneous velocity-direction deceleration; it does not establish the globally minimum endpoint speed over 10 ms. Likewise prediction_braking and a weight-changing local_comparison are distinct probes, not equivalent operations. The accepted check executes only prediction_braking.

actual_numerical_result.qualification: The probe has a lower predicted endpoint speed and higher endpoint position error under the braking input. This is retained local projected-model evidence; no revised model judgment consumed it, and no complete backend improvement or causal identification follows.
